issues.claim: Prism: its own navigation service, a dialog service, modules, convention-based view model location, DI container integration and its own startup process; a MAUI upgrade may wait for a compatible Prism release; check the license terms
issues.problem: Neither fetched excerpt mentions Prism beyond its name in a list of frameworks. The MAUI MVVM page says only that frameworks generally offer navigation helpers, DI and platform integration. The Prism-specific claims are accurate as far as I know. That includes the Prism 9 dual-license change that motivates the licence advice. The cited pages do not show them.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a Prism source (for example https://docs.prismlibrary.com/docs/maui/ and the Prism licensing page, kind docs, lang en) with a matching linkTitle in both locales. Or phrase the Prism claims as typical framework features, which the MAUI MVVM page supports.

issues.claim: Code is generated at build time ... properties need no runtime reflection ... which makes trimming of iOS and Android release builds easier
issues.problem: The cited toolkit introduction excerpt lists the types but never mentions the `[ObservableProperty]` and `[RelayCommand]` source generators. It says nothing about reflection or trimming. The claim is correct for generated properties and commands, but nothing cited supports it.
issues.suggestedFix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/communitytoolkit/mvvm/generators/observableproperty and the RelayCommand generator page as links. Optionally add the MAUI trimming page. Keep the claim limited to properties and commands, not ObservableValidator.

issues.claim: The MVVM pattern in enterprise .NET MAUI apps
issues.problem: The fetched page title is 'Model-View-ViewModel - .NET', so the link title does not match the page.
issues.suggestedFix: Use 'Model-View-ViewModel (MVVM) in .NET MAUI apps' / 'Паттерн Model-View-ViewModel в приложениях .NET MAUI'.

issues.claim: Отделите то, что вариант добавляет в модель представления, от того, что он забирает под себя в приложении (навигацию, запуск)
issues.problem: The hint almost restates the library-versus-framework distinction at the heart of the answer, so it is stronger than a nudge.
issues.suggestedFix: Shorten it, in both locales, to something like: 'Что вариант добавляет в модель представления, а что он забирает у приложения целиком? Что будет при обновлении MAUI?'

issues.claim: RequestAsync may show system UI, so it runs on the main thread (inside the service through MainThread.InvokeOnMainThreadAsync)
issues.problem: The permissions excerpt is truncated before any main-thread statement. The platform implementations do require the main thread, and MainThread.InvokeOnMainThreadAsync exists. The cited page does not show it.
issues.suggestedFix: Confirm that the permissions page states the main-thread requirement and quote it. Otherwise cite the main-thread page (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/maui/platform-integration/appmodel/main-thread) or drop the 'docs require it' framing.

issues.claim: on Android after repeated refusals the system stops showing the dialog, so RequestAsync returns Denied at once
issues.problem: The excerpt supports only that on iOS a Denied status should send the user to settings, and that on Android ShouldShowRationale detects an earlier denial. The Android 'don't ask again' behaviour is real Android platform behaviour. The cited MAUI page does not state it.
issues.suggestedFix: Attribute the behaviour to the Android runtime permissions documentation (add a link, for example https://developer.android.com/training/permissions/requesting) or word it as a platform behaviour without implying the MAUI docs say it.

issues.claim: Permissions.ShouldShowRationale<T>() returns true ... this happens only on Android; Restricted and Limited are typical of iOS
issues.problem: The excerpt says 'On Android, you can call ShouldShowRationale' and 'Limited ... Only iOS returns this status'. It does not say that ShouldShowRationale is always false elsewhere, or that Restricted is typical of iOS.
issues.suggestedFix: Weaken to 'ShouldShowRationale is meaningful on Android' and 'Limited is returned only on iOS', which the page supports. Or confirm the stronger wording in the full page.

issues.claim: Что, кроме самого вызова API, отличается между платформами - где разрешение объявляется и что происходит после того, как пользователь отказал?
issues.problem: The hint names two of the main answer points, the declaration location and denial behaviour, so it is close to giving the answer away. The English hint has the same strength.
issues.suggestedFix: Make it vaguer in both locales: 'Что, кроме самого вызова API, ведёт себя по-разному на Android и iOS - до первого запроса и после отказа пользователя?'
